knowledge_docs.title: Fernway price list
knowledge_docs.body:
Team plan: $12 per seat per month, billed monthly or annually.
Business plan: $20 per seat per month, billed annually. Includes SSO, scheduled CSV exports and guided onboarding (two 60-minute sessions).
Premium support add-on: $1,500 per year, 4-hour response time.
Quarterly invoicing on annual plans: available with a 3% surcharge.
Discounts: up to 5% may be offered for 50+ seats. Any other discount needs approval from the sales lead and must not be promised in writing before approval.
Quotes are valid for 30 days.

knowledge_docs.title: Customer FAQ
knowledge_docs.body:
Q: Can I export reports? A: Yes. Every report has Export > CSV. Scheduled exports are on the Business plan.
Q: Do you support SSO? A: Yes, SAML SSO on the Business plan.
Q: Is onboarding included? A: Guided onboarding is included in the annual Business plan. Team plan customers get self-serve guides.
Q: How do I change the billing contact? A: Account owners can change it in Settings > Billing, or we can change it on request.
Q: Do you sign NDAs? A: Yes. We use a standard mutual NDA and can review the customer's paper on request.

knowledge_docs.title: Manual excerpt: SSO sign-in troubleshooting
knowledge_docs.body: Known issue SSO-112: on Safari 18, SAML sign-in can loop back to the login page and show error ID LGN-4471. Cause: a cookie set without the SameSite attribute. Fix shipped in release 4.12 (rolls out to all workspaces within 48 hours of release). Workaround until then: sign in with Chrome or Firefox, or clear site cookies and retry.

knowledge_docs.title: Service terms summary
knowledge_docs.body: Annual plans renew automatically unless cancelled 30 days before renewal. Price changes apply at renewal only. Kickoff calls are scheduled within 10 business days of signup. Customer data is never shared before a signed NDA when a pilot uses customer data.
